declaration.purpose: pre-registered execution-friction stress model, not observed execution cost

cost_model.round_trip_definition: one total deduction covering entry plus exit for the complete trade
cost_model.gross_baseline_policy: GROSS_0BP is diagnostic only and is not a realistic execution scenario
cost_model.leg_allocation: NONE; total cost is not split between entry and exit
cost_model.numeric_policy: Decimal constructed from source price text; no intermediate rounding; display-only rounding

taxonomy.spread_adverse_execution: NOT_OBSERVED; covered only as generic stress friction
taxonomy.slippage: NOT_OBSERVED; covered only as generic stress friction
taxonomy.market_impact: NOT_YET_EXPLICITLY_MODELED; size is not frozen before E-D5
taxonomy.latency_queue_auction_uncertainty: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; covered only as generic stress friction
taxonomy.double_counting_rule: a later separately modeled broker fee or execution component must replace or explicitly reconcile the all-in stress component before use

limitations.low_price_caveat: 5-20 bp may understate friction for relatively low-priced names, but no price multiplier is permitted without a new pre-registered evidence-backed version
